subject.title: Dashboard shows deployment version drift warning

question: How should the dashboard classify a SHA mismatch produced by the supported backend-only or frontend-only production deployment targets?
rationale: Source and tests enforce a red alert for every complete mismatch while deployment automation explicitly permits operations that create one, so the intended severity, grace period, and convergence requirement cannot be inferred safely from code.

options.title: Make the warning deploy-aware
options.body: Record deployment target and time, show expected partial drift as a temporary lower-severity notice, and escalate only persistent or unintended skew.

options.title: Require SHA convergence
options.body: Keep the strict red alert and require every component-only production deployment to be followed by a same-SHA full deployment.

options.title: Move drift out of the UI
options.body: Remove the dashboard alert and expose mismatches only through deployment automation, logs, or operator diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Make the warning deploy-aware
recommendation.body: Record deployment target and time, show expected partial drift as a temporary lower-severity notice, and escalate only persistent or unintended skew.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the strongest current-history owner across the warning implementation, deployment workflow, and recent release infrastructure.
